plugins.name: Radio
plugins.description: Stations from Radio Browser, an open directory kept by its community. It needs no account.
plugins.author: vicrodh

plugins.name: Podcasts
plugins.description: Shows from PodcastIndex, an open index of podcasts: by language and category, with every episode. It needs no account.
plugins.author: vicrodh

plugins.name: Playlist Importer
plugins.description: Import public playlists and playlist files, then match their tracks against your local library and connected sources. Create local, mixed or source-owned playlists and review unmatched tracks. Source accounts remain in their own plugins. (Linux x86_64 only)
plugins.author: vicrodh

plugins.name: Chilpa DSP
plugins.description: Offline equalizer, crossfeed and listening presets. DSP modifies the signal; native DSD and DoP bypass processing.
plugins.author: vicrodh

plugins.name: Mood
plugins.description: Analyze local audio for mood and similarity. Optional models download only after enabling the plugin and permit noncommercial use. Linux x86_64 only.
plugins.author: vicrodh
